eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter One
subtitle: Lesson 6 · T-SQL Foundations

code:
SELECT FirstName + ' ' + LastName AS FullName
FROM Person.Person;
caption: + joins strings — first name, a literal space, then last name.

code:
SELECT 'Customer: ' + FirstName + ' ' + LastName AS Label
FROM Person.Person;
caption: Literal text and column values glue together in the order you write them.

code:
SELECT FirstName + ' ' + MiddleName + ' ' + LastName AS FullName
FROM Person.Person;
caption: If MiddleName is NULL, the ENTIRE result becomes NULL — even with valid first/last names.

code:
SELECT CONCAT(FirstName, ' ', MiddleName, ' ', LastName) AS FullName
FROM Person.Person;
caption: CONCAT() treats NULL as an empty string instead of poisoning the whole result.

subtitle: Branching logic, right inside a SELECT statement.
